stories.title: NTA seeks exam centres for 2027 testing cycle
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has invited schools, universities and testing agencies to apply as exam centres for NEET UG, JEE Main, CUET and other national tests. Interested institutions can submit expressions of interest for computer-based or pen-and-paper formats until December 6, 2026. The agency is currently seeking capacity.

stories.title: NTA recruits observers for national entrance exams
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency is accepting applications from government officials and academics to serve as exam observers for NEET UG, JEE Main and other national tests. Applications for the role remain open until December 6. The agency is looking for monitors to oversee the upcoming examination cycle.

stories.title: NTA releases JEE Main 2027 schedule
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has announced dates for JEE Main 2027. Session 1 will run from January 20 to 24 and January 28, while Session 2 is scheduled for April 2 to 7. Registration details and eligibility criteria are now available on the official NTA website.

stories.title: JEE Main 2027 registration deadline approaches
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency will close registration for JEE Main Session 1 on November 22, 2026. Candidates must complete their applications via the official portal, which now requires a MeriPehchan login. Students are advised to verify eligibility requirements before submitting their forms for the upcoming exam sessions.

stories.summary: The Indian Institute of Management has released admit cards for the Common Admission Test 2026. Eligible candidates can download their hall tickets from the official website at iimcat.ac.in. The institute has confirmed that all cards for registered participants are now available for retrieval.

stories.title: Australia tightens student visa rules
stories.summary: Australia has restricted temporary visa holders from switching to student visas while in the country. The changes, effective October 2, also limit the inclusion of family members in applications. The government says the move is a crackdown on visa switching, affecting those currently on temporary work permits.

stories.title: Canada maintains 2027 international student targets
stories.summary: Canada’s 2027 to 2029 Immigration Levels Plan sets a target of 150,000 international student arrivals for 2027. This figure remains unchanged from the previous year's plan. The government also aims to admit 220,000 temporary workers as part of its broader strategy for managing temporary resident arrivals.

stories.title: International students reconsider Australian education
stories.summary: Australia’s international education industry is facing pressure as students report second thoughts due to high visa fees, rising living costs and changes to work rights. The sector, valued at $54 billion, is navigating a shift in appeal as students weigh the costs of an Australian degree.

stories.title: Arizona universities report drop in international enrollment
stories.summary: Arizona's three public universities report significant declines in international student enrollment, attributing the trend to federal immigration and visa policies. Northern Arizona University saw the steepest drop at 32 percent. The American Council on Education describes the decline as part of a broader national pattern.

stories.title: Australia assures India on visa process
stories.summary: Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri stated that Australia has assured India its more rigorous visa processes will not reduce opportunities for genuine Indian students. The assurance follows discussions regarding concerns over changes to the student visa assessment framework and reports of processing delays during recent diplomatic engagements.

stories.title: Canada extends student intake targets through 2029
stories.summary: The Canadian government will maintain its annual target of 150,000 international student arrivals through 2029. The extension is part of a wider goal to welcome 370,000 temporary residents each year. The targets remain consistent with those established in the previous immigration plan.

stories.title: Australia details training visa requirements
stories.summary: Australia is offering a Subclass 407 Training Visa allowing eligible foreigners to stay for up to two years for workplace-based training. The visa costs from AUD 535 and requires applicants to secure an approved sponsor and nomination before lodging an application with the Department of Home Affairs.

stories.title: Australia considers stricter financial proof for student visas
stories.summary: Australia is considering reforms to student visa financial requirements, potentially mandating that applicants transfer funds into local bank accounts and maintain a balance before applying. The government says the changes aim to ensure affordability and transparency. The department is currently consulting on the proposal.

stories.title: Australia consults on student visa reforms
stories.summary: Assistant Minister for International Education Julian Hill has announced plans to revise the Genuine Student test and strengthen financial requirements to discourage visa hopping. The government is seeking feedback from sector stakeholders following a year of record visa rejections and declining student commencements.

stories.title: South Korea cuts regional visa slots
stories.summary: South Korea has reduced the total cap for its region-specific visa programme from 6,790 to approximately 3,000 slots. The Ministry of Justice announced the overhaul for the 2027 to 28 edition, with applications closing on November 10, 2026. The programme targets foreign nationals living outside the Seoul metropolitan area.

stories.title: IDP Education faces policy headwinds
stories.summary: IDP Education is being assessed on whether international student demand can recover from recent Australian policy shifts. The company's performance remains tied to visa settings and education-policy changes. Investors are waiting for a formal update to see if the firm's counselling network can offset the current environment.

stories.title: Sour Patch Kids funds HBCU scholarship programme
stories.summary: Sour Patch Kids partnered with the Thurgood Marshall College Fund for a $1 million scholarship initiative. The Mischief for Change Scholarship, supported by Chris Paul, offers financial assistance to students at Historically Black Colleges and Universities and Predominantly Black Institutions. Ten students are eligible for $16,700 each.

stories.title: Khalil Mack launches scholarship for Florida students
stories.summary: NFL player Khalil Mack and his wife Brianna have launched a scholarship programme committing $270,400 to 52 Florida students. The Khalil Mack 52 Scholars Program awards $5,200 to each recipient. The initiative is open to African-American students with a GPA of 3.0 or higher.

stories.title: Ntha Foundation offers AI and digital skills access
stories.summary: The Ntha Foundation has opened applications for its 2027 AI and Digital Skills Scholarship. The initiative provides funded access to over 100 online courses through Digital Skills for Africa. The scholarship is not a cash grant, but provides access to training in emerging technologies.

stories.title: NNPC-SNEPCo scholarship details
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Information regarding the 2026 NNPC-SNEPCo scholarship eligibility and application process is currently behind a verification wall. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: NNPC and Shell open undergraduate scholarship
stories.summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company and Shell Nigeria Exploration and Production Company have opened applications for the 2026 National University Scholarship Award. Full-time second-year students in public Nigerian universities with a CGPA of 3.5 or higher are eligible to receive annual grants until graduation.

stories.title: Amrita University opens engineering entrance registration
stories.summary: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham has opened registration for the AEEE 2027 entrance exam. The university will conduct the computer-based test between April 15 and May 7, 2027. Candidates may apply for BTech admission using their AEEE rank or JEE Main 2027 percentile.

stories.title: Odisha re-opens scholarship portal
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. The Odisha government has re-opened the portal for the Mukhyamantri Medhabi Chhatra Protsahan Yojana, allowing students to apply for state-sponsored financial support. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: University of Liverpool offers chemistry PhD studentship
stories.summary: The University of Liverpool has announced a 3.5-year fully funded PhD position in chemistry. The studentship includes an annual stipend of £21,805, tuition fee support, and additional research funding. The project focuses on the development of sustainable methods.

stories.title: Odisha announces new scholarship application dates
stories.summary: The Odisha Higher Education Department has set the application window for the 2026-27 Mukhyamantri Medhabi Chhatra Protsahan Yojana. Eligible students can apply for five different merit and assistance schemes between November 5 and November 20, 2026. This represents the second phase for fresh applicants.

stories.title: Student receives $40,000 New Zealand scholarship
stories.summary: Nguyen Hoang Lam, an 18-year-old student, has been awarded a 65,000 NZD scholarship package. The award includes 15,000 NZD from the New Zealand Government and 50,000 NZD from the University of Otago. The student previously achieved a 1580 SAT score.

stories.title: Kyoto University opens research internship applications
stories.summary: Kyoto University is accepting applications for the 2027 Amgen Scholars Program. The nine-week research internship in Japan offers selected undergraduate students accommodation and a scholarship worth ¥180,000. Participants will conduct scientific research and attend a symposium in Tokyo.

stories.title: Hanyang University reaches 19th in Asia rankings
stories.summary: Hanyang University ranked 19th in the 2027 QS Asia University Rankings, matching its previous all-time high. The university's overall score rose to 93.8, with improvements noted in its international research network indicator. It remains the sixth-ranked institution in South Korea.

stories.title: Chandigarh University retains top private rank in Asia
stories.summary: Chandigarh University has been named India's number one private university for the fourth consecutive year in the QS Asia University Rankings 2027. The institution climbed to 104th place among all Asian universities, with its overall score increasing to 70.3.

stories.title: Jouf University ranked in Arab University list
stories.summary: Jouf University has been ranked 38th in the Times Higher Education Arab University Rankings 2027. The institution appeared in the latest regional assessment of higher education performance. Further details regarding the methodology and specific institutional metrics are currently unavailable due to site security restrictions.

stories.title: VNU-HCM leads in academic and employer reputation
stories.summary: Việt Nam National University-HCM City has maintained its leading national position in academic reputation and employer prestige in the 2027 QS Asia University Rankings. The university saw its academic reputation score climb 12 places. These two criteria account for 50 percent of the total evaluation score.

stories.title: SRM University-AP earns regional ranking
stories.summary: SRM University-AP, Amaravati, has been included in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2027. The university is placed within the top 100 in Southern Asia and the top 51 in India. It also holds the top position among all universities in Andhra Pradesh.

stories.title: Parul University moves up in Asia rankings
stories.summary: Parul University has moved into the 791-800 band in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2027, up from the 1001-1100 band last year. The institution also debuted in the Southern Asia category at 239th place. The rankings evaluate universities using 11 different performance indicators.

stories.title: NCHE outlines accreditation for Malawi universities
stories.summary: Malawi currently hosts six public universities and over 30 private institutions authorized by the National Council for Higher Education. The council manages both legal registration and academic accreditation. Students are advised to verify both statuses before enrollment, as rankings serve a separate function from basic regulatory compliance.

stories.title: Lovely Professional University rises in rankings
stories.summary: Lovely Professional University has reached 154th place in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2027, rising 33 spots. The university claims to have surpassed several Indian Institutes of Technology and all National Institutes of Technology. It is now ranked 2nd among private universities in India.

stories.title: Bharathiar University reports ranking progress
stories.summary: Bharathiar University has been placed in the 711-720 band of the QS World University Rankings 2026-27. The university also secured 44th position in the QS Asia rankings, an improvement from 47th last year. Officials described the shift as a testament to the dedication of the academic community.

stories.title: New entries join QS Asia University Rankings
stories.summary: The QS Asia University Rankings 2027, released November 3, includes both established global leaders and new institutional entrants. While top-tier rankings remain stable, the addition of specialized colleges and new branches in the 407 to 1501+ range suggests a shifting landscape for regional academic environments.

stories.title: Central Philippine University maintains ranking
stories.summary: Central Philippine University is ranked 22nd in the Philippines and within the 1301-1400 bracket in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2027. The institution also placed 205th in Southeast Asia. Rankings were determined by indicators including research, learning experience, and global engagement.

stories.title: State board students face exam scheduling conflicts
stories.summary: The CBSE has announced 2027 board exams for classes 10 and 12 will begin February 16. West Bengal state board exams are expected to be delayed until late March due to census requirements. Students and teachers anticipate challenges preparing for competitive exams scheduled for April and May.

stories.title: DHS proposes high fees for student work permits
stories.summary: The Department of Homeland Security has proposed a rule to charge schools 70,000 dollars for every F-1 international student applying for Optional Practical Training. The program currently allows students to gain work experience related to their field of study for up to 12 months.

stories.title: Columbia student released after detention
stories.summary: A Columbia University student detained by Department of Homeland Security agents was released following a conversation between New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and President Donald Trump. The university stated that agents had misrepresented themselves to gain entry to the student's dormitory.

stories.title: Policy changes threaten student work opportunities
stories.summary: Proposed federal immigration rules could require universities to pay 70,000 dollars for initial Optional Practical Training recommendations and 30,000 dollars for subsequent ones. The University of Wisconsin is pursuing legal action and advocacy in response to these potential changes affecting international student internships and employment.

stories.title: Cornell faculty approve no confidence resolution
stories.summary: The Cornell University Faculty Senate has approved a resolution of no confidence in the administration. The vote followed allegations of sexual assault and criticism regarding the university's response. Just over 55 percent of faculty senators voted in favor of the measure, while 37 percent voted against it.

stories.title: Cornell leadership faces faculty no confidence vote
stories.summary: Cornell University faculty have passed a no confidence resolution against top leaders following a former student's lawsuit regarding an alleged 2024 fraternity gang rape. The resolution passed 75-50 after weeks of debate over how the administration handled the allegations. It remains a symbolic gesture of campus discontent.

stories.title: DOJ sues Penn State over in-state tuition policies
stories.summary: The Department of Justice has filed a lawsuit against Penn State regarding its in-state tuition policies for undocumented students. The federal agency appears to be turning its sights on individual colleges after previously filing lawsuits over similar policies at the state level. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: University of Maine offers buyouts to 158 faculty members
stories.summary: The University of Maine is offering buyouts to 158 faculty members as it attempts to address a $19 million structural deficit. Leaders of the public institution say they are trying to minimize layoffs while slashing the budget. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Students petition for third JEE Advanced attempt
stories.summary: More than 13,500 students have signed a petition demanding a third attempt at the JEE Advanced exam. The group argues the current two-attempt limit disadvantages those balancing board exams. They have urged the Joint Admission Board and Ministry of Education to expand the window for testing.

stories.title: ASUC opposes $100,000 international student work fee
stories.summary: The Associated Students of the University of California are calling on the university to oppose a $100,000 fee for international student work authorization. The student government is seeking institutional support against the cost. The full piece is for subscribers.
